steps.text: VERY IMPORTANT: If you want to make this alt into a slayer lure alt, DO NOT complete the following quests:

steps.title: Dragon Slayer 1, Priest in Peril, …
steps.text: Dragon Slayer 1, Priest in Peril, Elemental workshop, Contact!, Death Plateau, Olaf's quest, Cabin fever, Regicide and Desert Treasure

steps.title: Note on Magic training: When away …
steps.text: Note on Magic training: When away from PC, if possible, fire strike/bolt sand crabs on hosidius beach (Chrome remote desktop / Mobile) (NPC aggression timer)

steps.title: Once you get 55 magic you …
steps.text: Once you get 55 magic you can also alch during questing, goal is 82 for magic imbue OR 75 on an alt
steps.note: Fastest: enchant gem-tipped bolts (expensive). Cheaper passive: cast Low Level Alchemy from 21 while doing other things.

steps.title: Best item to alch: Rune arrows
steps.text: Best item to alch: Rune arrows

steps.title: Use quest helper plugin on RuneLite …
steps.text: Use quest helper plugin on RuneLite for optimal questing!

steps.title: This does not inlcude all quest …
steps.text: This does not inlcude all quest items, just buy them as you get around to do each quest
